chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu al-Subah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who has a female slave for one of his children, while his children are young, is it permissible for him to consummate the marriage with her? He said: He appraises her at a fair price, then takes her, and the value becomes a debt owed by the child to him.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a father marries a female slave for his young child?
ai.summary: This ruling from al- Istibsar clarifies the mechanism of 'tamlik' (acquisition) where a father consummates marriage with a slave owned by his minor child, treating the slave's value as a debt the child owes him. This ensures the child's property rights are preserved while allowing the father to exercise his marital rights, reflecting the practical legal nuances of the Shia fiqh regarding mixed ownership and guardianship. The appraisal (qimah) must be just, preventing the father from undervaluing the child's asset to his benefit.
